description: `rustdesk --assign --token <t>` with every option: the body carries id and uuid plus each given option (the address_book_* details only with address_book_name). A token with the assign scope places the device: owner, strategy, device group, note, device names and a shared address book entry. Success is 200 with an empty body (the CLI prints "Done!"); what was placed is checked in crates/deskhaven-contract/tests/devices_cli.rs and crates/deskhaven-core/tests/devices/assign.rs.
